comment: Healthy model/prompt version — near-exact answers. Mapped to test_case_id UUIDs by run_demo.py.

refund-policy.answer: You can request a full refund within 30 days of purchase with your order number.

password-reset.answer: Open the login page, click Forgot password, and follow the email link we send you.

account-deletion.answer: Go to Settings, choose Privacy, then Delete account. Deletion is permanent after 7 days.

shipping-time.answer: Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days. Express shipping arrives in 1 to 2 business days.

cancel-subscription.answer: Open Billing, select your plan, and click Cancel subscription. Access continues until the end of the billing period.

contact-support.answer: Email support@example.com or use in-app chat Monday through Friday, 9am to 6pm Eastern.

update-payment.answer: Go to Billing, choose Payment methods, then Add or replace your card. Changes apply to the next invoice.

track-order.answer: Open Orders, select your order, and view the tracking link once the package has shipped.

change-email.answer: Yes. Open Settings, edit Email, confirm the new address from the verification message we send.

return-label.answer: Start a return from Orders, choose the items, and download the prepaid label we generate for eligible products.
